notes: health.taxonomy_release is the fixture-corpus process release used by /v1/answers and /v1/search, not the AviList reference-taxonomy release served by /v1/taxa/lineage -- the two are unrelated data areas.
health reports process release 'fixture-avlist-2025'; lineage reports AviList release 'v2025b'. A difference between these two values is expected and is not a defect by itself.
